subject: CS230
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos, one for each of the 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The selections prioritize high relevance to the specific university-level concepts, educational quality, and peer validation as indicated by high view counts. All hard gates and non-negotiable rules were followed, resulting in a curated list of foundational and explanatory videos from respected educational channels.

coverage.note: Many candidates were ineligible due to being in Hindi/Urdu.
The two most relevantly titled candidates were ineligible due to low view counts (<3000).
Many candidates were too basic, targeting middle school curricula, and thus failed the relevance gate.

videos.title: Java is ALWAYS Pass By Value. Here's Why
videos.filter_reason: Perfectly explains the common confusion point for Java students regarding how primitives and object references are passed.

videos.title: Type promotions in Java || Method overloading with type promotion [IMP Interview Concept]
videos.filter_reason: Directly explains 'argument promotion' in Java and its practical application in method overloading, a perfect fit for the topic.

videos.title: Methods in Java | Overloading | Signature | Mutability
videos.filter_reason: This video is perfectly titled, covering both method overloading and method signatures in detail with high relevance.
